archetypes.name: semantics-guard
archetypes.rationale: The two timeout knobs intentionally keep different fallback semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan preserves per-knob semantics. Focus on `LARCH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` invalid, empty, and zero fallback behavior versus `LARCH_EXTERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT` zero opt-out behavior. Flag any test or code change that accidentally normalizes these semantics into one shared rule. Cite the relevant plan file headings and code paths in your findings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scope-guard
archetypes.rationale: The change is blocked by #4756 but must not implement retry-budget work here.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check for scope creep. Ensure the plan only bumps defaults and docs/tests, with no retry-budget logic, no new env vars, and no per-attempt versus total timeout model change. Flag any suggested implementation detail that belongs to #4756 instead. Cite the relevant plan file headings and code paths in your findings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
